abilities.effect: The hall's last 40 feet of walls angle inward, causing the hall to shrink and contract down, reaching 6 inches in height and width at the hall's far end and completely blocking access to the hall's exit door for anything but a Tiny creature Squeezing.
abilities.name: Shrink
abilities.trigger: 100 pounds of weight or more is placed on the hallway's floor

hazard.description: This hallway is designed to shrink as creatures traverse it, making access to the door at the hall's end impossible.
hazard.disable: DC 21 Thievery (trained) to jam the scales built into the floor
hazard.name: Shrinking Hall
hazard.reset: After 10 minutes without weight being placed on this hall's floor, this trap resets, returning the hall to its original size.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
